# X17-catalog-refresh: The catalog refresh on Codex: read-only, ephemeral, config {web_search:"live"}, the refresh's strict output schema as turn/start outputSchema (params.ts strictOutputSchema); web searches, a commentary message, then the final answer (JSON), reported as the structuredOutput meta signal.
# Recorded with codex-cli 0.160.1 (read-only feature switches: features.apps, features.plugins, features.hooks = false) (a ChatGPT login, the Windows sandbox ready); the published fixture is synthesized from that recording (scripts/synthesize-fixtures.mjs), which stays private.
# The model is pinned as Dim Factory sends a picked one (gpt-6-luna, model/list default): the profile configures a model a ChatGPT login is refused (X09h).
# The turn text is a refresh prompt rendered by src/core/catalog/refresh.ts renderRefreshPrompt (vendors ['codex'], the seed prices, the models of the live X01a model/list, today 2026-10-10). The header's pass.prompt stays "<REDACTED>": the replay takes the prompt from turn/start.
# The first live attempt sent the non-strict schema and was refused (400 invalid_json_schema, no token spent); the adapter now sends the strict form, which stdin.jsonl carries.
# --allow-user-codex-home only when <CODEX_HOME> is your own ~/.codex.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox> (Dim Factory itself runs a refresh in its job folder).
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --codex-app-server --bin "<codex.exe>" --codex-home "<CODEX_HOME>" --allow-user-codex-home --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures-private/codex/app-server/X17-catalog-refresh --id X17 --slug catalog-refresh --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --timeout 900000 --stdin tests/fixtures/codex/recipes/X17-catalog-refresh/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/codex/recipes/X17-catalog-refresh/pass.json
